name: Dhaka
title: Dhaka: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Dhaka, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: Dhaka has two strands of heat work. Dhaka North appointed Asia's first city Chief Heat Officer in 2023, with water booths, plans for cooling zones and greening. The Red Crescent has the most tested system: an early action protocol that, in April 2024, released cash, cooling stations and water before the worst heat. A city heat action plan is still proposed.

unknowns: How many people received each kind of support in 2024 (a post-activation report exists but was not read).

equity.receiving: Elderly people, outdoor workers and other vulnerable residents in six areas.

activities.title: Red Crescent early action for heatwaves
activities.desc: A protocol that releases money and action once a heat forecast crosses a threshold. In April 2024 it was activated for the first time: cash grants, cooling stations at three locations, ambulance support, early warnings and drinking water.
activities.place: Adabor, Gendaria, Kamrangir Char, Lalbagh, Mohammadpur and Pallabi; warnings city-wide

activities.title: Urban heat support with the German and Danish Red Cross
activities.desc: Work with urban working-class people, with planned healthcare and cash grants for vulnerable families.

activities.title: Chief Heat Officer and city heat measures
activities.desc: A Chief Heat Officer to lead Dhaka North's heat response, with 100 water booths, planned cooling zones, tree planting, parks and a tax incentive for rooftop gardens.

activities.title: Climate action plans for both city corporations
activities.desc: Climate action plans for Dhaka North and Dhaka South.

activities.title: City heat mapping for a proposed Heat Action Plan
activities.desc: A year of microclimate data from more than 20 points (parks, slums, water bodies and built-up areas) to inform a proposed Heat Action Plan and the National Adaptation Plan.
activities.place: More than 20 points across the capital
